Sakunoshin is a serious-looking young man who protects Princess Suzune in any ease. He is the one of soldiers who fights to protect Ohbanahara; however, due to his overprotective nature, he is easy to jump to conclusions.

'''Sakunoshin''' is a non-playable-character (NPC) and one of Princess [[Suzune]]'s retainers. He is first met at Prosperity Fields at Ohbanahara. He is first met as "Serious Young Man".

==Personality==
Sakunoshin is a serious-looking young man who protects Princess Suzune in any ease. He is the one of soldiers who fights to protect Ohbanahara; however, due to his overprotective nature, he is easy to jump to conclusions.

<!--
==In the Storyline==
When Summoner, Tilith and Seria arrived to Prosperity Fields with Suzune, he was called Suzune while written as "Young Man's Voice". But he unlikelyable to trust strangers and think that Summoner's Team and Genba's minions, thinking they're using clever lies to distract Sakunoshin out from Suzune. The player mets him again at the Defensive Checkpoint, where he tells player that he knows the way to go inside the palace. However, the Summoner's party and Sakunoshin was captured by Genba. And forced to battle with Genba, after battle victory from Genba, a mysterious begging monk comes and help the rest of the party to head further in progress to go inside Ohbanahara capital.
